ノースハーバー・ドキュメントサービスの移行計画

移行は11月21日（土）01:00から04:00（UTC）に予定されています。本通知を通じて、これらの時刻はUTC表記となっており、明示的なラベルがない限り、現地時刻に置き換えてはなりません。メンテナンス期間はあくまで最大許容時間であり、3時間サービスが利用不能になることを保証するものではありません。利用者は引き続き、以前に公開されたドキュメントを閲覧できます。新規ドキュメントの作成およびアクセス権限の変更は一時的に無効化されます。メンテナンス期間前に生成されたダウンロードリンクは、元の有効期限まで引き続き利用可能です。

期間開始前に、運用チームは権限テーブルをエクスポートし、各エクスポートファイルのチェックサムを算出する必要があります。エクスポート成功のメッセージだけでは、バックアップが利用可能であることの十分な証拠にはなりません。チームはサンプルを1件、隔離されたテスト環境に復元し、レコード数とアクセスルールの両方を比較する必要があります。サンプルを本番環境に復元しないでください。テスト環境は通知メールを送信してはならず、復元プロセスによって自動的に有効になった場合でも、スケジュール済みのジョブは無効なままである必要があります。

第1段階では、研究部門が所有するドキュメントを移行します。第2段階では、財務部門を除くすべての部門が所有するドキュメントを移行します。財務部門のドキュメントは、財務マネージャーが別途検証レポートを承認するまで、旧システムに保持されます。研究段階の承認は、財務部門のドキュメントの承認を意味するものではありません。共有ドキュメントは、最後に編集した担当者の部門ではなく、所有者によって分類されます。したがって、財務部門と共有されているが研究部門が所有するドキュメントは、第1段階に属します。

検証期間中、ランダムに選択した200件のドキュメントを原本と比較します。すべてのドキュメント識別子、作成日、添付ファイル名、および権限エントリが一致している必要があります。プレーンテキストの説明文内における空白文字の差異は無視して構いませんが、ソースコード添付ファイル内の差異は無視してはなりません。いずれかの権限エントリが原本よりも広範なアクセス権限を付与している場合は、直ちに移行を停止してください。不足している任意の説明文は、後で修正するために記録してください。それら自体でロールバックを行う必要はありません。この区別により、チームは不足している添付ファイルを無視することはできません。

ロールバックは、代替システムで最初の新規ドキュメントが作成されるまで利用可能です。その後、新規書き込みを整合させずに旧データベースを復元すると、ユーザーデータが失われる可能性があります。新規書き込み開始後に重大な不具合が発見された場合は、直ちにデータベースを復元するのではなく、読み取り専用モードに切り替え、インシデントコーディネーターに連絡してください。整合が必要かどうかの判断は、ベンダーではなくコーディネーターが行います。その決定をインシデントログに記録してください。

最後に、移行した各部門の所有者がアクセスを確認した後にのみ、完了通知を送信してください。財務部門のドキュメントがまだ旧システムに残っている場合、財務部門が移行したと主張しないでください。元のバックアップを14日間保持し、その後、保持責任者が書面で承認を与えた後にのみ削除してください。14日間は最低保持期間であり、自動削除の期限ではありません。移行計画終了。

North Port Document Service Migration Plan

In the first phase, documents owned by the Research Division will be migrated. In the second phase, documents from the remaining divisions, excluding the Finance Division, will be migrated. Therefore, documents owned by the Research Division—even if they are shared with the Finance Division—are subject to the first phase.

During verification, compare 200 randomly selected documents with the originals. Identifiers, creation dates, attachment filenames, and permissions must all match. Differences in whitespace in the plain text descriptions may be ignored, but differences in whitespace within source code attachments must not be ignored. If any permission is found that allows access wider than the original, stop the migration immediately. If any description is empty, record it for later correction, but there is no need to roll back based on that alone. This does not mean missing attachments can be ignored.

Rollbacks are permitted until the first new document is created in the new system. Restoring the old database after that without verifying new writes risks losing user data. If a major failure is discovered after new writes have started, do not restore immediately; switch to read-only and contact the failure response officer. The failure response officer, not the vendor, should determine whether verification is necessary. Record that decision in the failure record.

Finally, the owner of each migrated division will verify access before issuing a completion notice. If finance documents remain on the old system, do not state to the Finance Division that they have been migrated. Regional Library Meeting Records

At the meeting on Tuesday, no one opposed the idea of extending the evening opening hours. However, not everyone agreed directly with the proposal presented. Nomura, who is in charge of volunteering, said that while they could add two days of evening service in December, they could not promise to maintain the same system in January. The chairperson requested that this be recorded as a temporary offer rather than a permanent staffing commitment. Of the three who offered their cooperation, only two have completed the necessary training.

The budget proposal is 480,000 yen including tax. This includes lighting, cleaning, and temporary security contracts, but does not include the cost of purchasing new computers. The subsidy will cover up to 60% of eligible expenses, but the limit is 240,000 yen. The treasurer pointed out that simply multiplying the full budget by 60% would exceed the limit and that the compensation amount would be incorrect. The subsidy has been applied for, but the grant has not yet been decided. Do not explain to residents that the funding for extended opening hours has been fully secured.

Opinions also differed regarding the phrase "Anyone can use it" in the announcement. A usage card is not required to enter the reading room, but registration is still required to borrow books. Children under 12 visiting after 19:00 will be required to be accompanied by an adult. This restriction applies only to evening hours; existing daytime rules will not be changed. The proposal to list all children under 18 was not adopted, as it would inadvertently extend the restriction to older students.

During the discussion, an email from the building manager was introduced. It stated, "We will make the entrance available by next Friday." At first, this was interpreted as meaning the entire renovation would be finished, but the next sentence stated that painting in the west corridor would continue for another week and would be closed during that time. Only the entrance and the path to the reading room would be usable. The manager promised access to only part of the building, not the completion of the entire renovation.

The committee agreed to conduct trials on December 8 and 15, provided that safety inspections are completed by December 5. If inspections are delayed, they will be cancelled on both days and will not be automatically postponed to the following week. Those who reserved study seats will be contacted individually. General visitors will be notified via the website. Simply posting a cancellation notice is not a substitute for contacting those with reservations.

As he was leaving, the chairperson thanked Mr. Nomura, saying, "You saved the plan." Mr. Nomura laughed and replied, "Let's first see if we could save two nights." This is a cautious statement; he did not reject the idea itself. The secretary added that the change to permanent opening hours has not been approved and that the trial results would be considered before making a decision regarding January. The meeting ended without a vote on the permanent proposal. This is the meeting record.

The migration work is scheduled from 01:00 to 04:00 UTC on Saturday, November 21st. All times in this notice are in UTC, and they must not be converted to local time without explicit indication. This three hours is the maximum window available for work and does not mean the service will necessarily stop for three hours. Viewing of published documents will remain possible. The creation of new documents and changes to access permissions will be temporarily suspended. Download links issued before the work can be used until their original expiration date.

Before starting the work, the operations personnel must print the permission table and calculate the checksum for each output file. A message stating that the output was successful is not sufficient to determine if the backup is recoverable. A sample must be restored to the isolated test environment, and both the quantity and the access rules must be cross-checked. Samples must not be restored to the production environment. Do not send notification emails from the test environment. Even if regular jobs are automatically enabled by the restoration process, the jobs must be returned to the disabled state.

In Phase 1, documents owned by the research department will be migrated. In Phase 2, documents from all departments except the finance department will be migrated. Documents from the finance department will remain on the old system until a different verification report is approved by the finance manager. Approval for the research department does not mean approval for the finance documents. Shared documents will be classified by the owner, not by the last person who edited them. Therefore, documents owned by the research department, even if shared with the finance department, are subject to Phase 1.

During verification, compare 200 randomly selected documents with the originals. The identifier, creation date, attachment filename, and permission items must match. Differences in whitespace in the plain text description can be ignored, but differences in whitespace within the attached source code must not be ignored. If even one permission allowing broader access than the original is found, stop the migration immediately. If an optional description field is empty, it will be recorded for correction later, but this does not mean that missing attachments can be ignored.

Rollback is possible until the first new document is created in the new system. If new writes are performed without cross-checking after that, restoring the old database risks losing user data. If a major failure is discovered after starting new writes, do not restore immediately; switch to read-only mode and contact the incident response manager. It is the incident response manager, not the vendor, who will judge the necessity of cross-checking. Record that judgment in the incident log.

Finally, after confirming access by the owner of each migrated department, a completion notice will be issued. If finance documents remain on the old system, it must not be stated that the finance department has been migrated. The original backup will be retained for 14 days, and after that, it will be deleted only with written approval from the preservation management manager. 14 days is the minimum retention period and not an automatic deletion deadline. This is the migration plan.

Regional Library Meeting Minutes

At the Tuesday meeting, no one opposed the idea of extending the evening opening hours. However, not everyone agreed with the proposal as presented. Mr. Nomura, who is in charge of volunteers, said that while they could increase evening coverage by two days in December, they could not promise to maintain the same structure in January. The meeting concluded without a vote on the permanent plan. These are the meeting minutes.

北港文書サービス移行計画

移行は11月21日土曜日の01:00から04:00 UTCに予定されています。本通知全体を通して、これらの時間はUTC表記であり、明示的なラベルなしに現地時間に置き換えてはなりません。メンテナンスウィンドウは最大許容時間であり、サービスが3時間利用不可になることを保証するものではありません。ユーザーは以前に公開された文書を閲覧し続けることができます。新規文書の作成とアクセス許可の変更は一時的に無効になります。メンテナンスウィンドウの前に生成されたダウンロードリンクは、元の有効期限まで機能し続けます。

ウィンドウ開始前に、運用チームは権限テーブルをエクスポートし、各エクスポートファイルに対してチェックサムを計算しなければなりません。単に成功したエクスポートメッセージだけでは、バックアップが使用可能であることの十分な証拠にはなりません。チームはサンプルを隔離されたテスト環境にリストし、レコード数とアクセスルールを両方比較する必要があります。サンプルを本番環境にリストしてはいけません。テスト環境は通知メールを送信してはならず、リストの復元プロセスが自動的に有効にした場合でも、スケジュールされたジョブは無効のまま維持されなければなりません。

第一段階では研究部門が所有する文書を移動します。第二段階では財務部門を除くすべての部門が所有する文書を移動します。財務文書は、財務マネージャーが別途検証レポートを承認するまで旧システムに残ります。研究段階の承認は、財務文書の承認を意味しません。共有文書は、最後に編集した人物の部門ではなく、所有者によって分類されます。したがって、研究部門が所有し、財務部門と共有されている文書は第一段階に属します。

検証中、ランダムに選択された200の文書をオリジナルと比較します。すべての文書識別子、作成日、添付ファイル名、および権限エントリは一致しなければなりません。プレーンテキストの説明内の空白の違いは無視しても構いませんが、ソースコード添付ファイル内の違いは無視してはなりません。いずれかの権限エントリがオリジナルよりも広範なアクセスを許可している場合は、直ちに移行を停止してください。欠落しているオプションの説明は後で修正するために記録する必要があります。それ自体がロールバックを必要とするわけではありません。この区別は、チームが欠落している添付ファイルを無視することを許可するものではありません。

ロールバックは、代替システムで最初の新規文書が作成されるまで利用可能です。そのイベントの後、新しい書き込みを調整せずに古いデータベースを復元すると、ユーザーデータが失われる可能性があります。新しい書き込みが開始された後に重大な欠陥が発見された場合は、直ちにデータベースを復元するのではなく、読み取り専用モードに切り替えてインシデントコーディネーターに連絡してください。コーディネーターがベンダーではなく、調整が必要かどうかを決定します。その決定をインシデントログに記録してください。

最後に、移行された各部門の所有者がアクセスを確認した後でのみ完了通知を送信してください。財務の文書がまだ旧システムにある場合、財務が移動したと主張しないでください。元のバックアップは14日間保持し、保持担当者が書面で承認した後でのみ削除してください。14日間は最低保持期間であり、自動削除の期限ではありません。移行計画終了。

火曜日に図書館委員会が会った際、夕方の開館時間を延長することに異議を唱える者は誰もいませんでした。しかし、それは全員が提案された内容を支持したことを意味するわけではありません。ボランティアを管理するノラは、12月にさらに2日間対応できるが、1月に同じ手配を約束することはできないと述べました。議長は書記に対し、これを恒久的な人員配置のコミットメントとしてではなく、一時的な申し出として記録するよう求めました。3人のボランティアが協力を申し出ていましたが、必要なトレーニングを完了したのは2人だけでした。

草案の通知にある「誰でも利用可能」という表現についても意見の相違がありました。利用者は閲覧室に入るために図書館カードを必要としませんが、本の貸出には依然として登録が必要です。12歳未満の子供は19:00以降、付き添いの大人が必要です。この制限は夕方の訪問のみに関わるものであり、日中の訪問に関する既存の規則を変更するものではありませんでした。委員会は、18歳未満のすべての訪問者を子供と記述するという提案を却下しました。なぜなら、それはより年長の生徒にまで制限を誤って拡大してしまうからです。

議論の途中で、ケンはビル管理者からのEメールを読みました。「来週の金曜日までに入口を公開できます」と書かれていました。ケンは当初、これは改修がその時までに完了することを意味すると解釈しました。ノラは次の文に気づきました。西側の廊下での塗装はさらに1週間続く予定であり、その廊下は閉鎖されたままであるということです。利用可能になるのは入口と閲覧室へのルートのみでした。管理者は建物の一部へのアクセスを約束しただけで、改修全体の完了を約束したわけではありませんでした。

Kitami Document Service Migration Plan

The migration work is scheduled from 01:00 to 04:00 UTC on Saturday, November 21st. All times in this notice are expressed in UTC, and they must not be replaced with local time without explicit indication. These three hours are the maximum window available for the work, and it does not mean that the service will be down for exactly three hours. Viewing of published documents will continue to be possible. The creation of new documents and changes to access permissions will be temporarily suspended. Download links issued before the work begins can be used until their original expiration date.

Before starting the work, the operations staff must output the permissions table and calculate the checksum for each output file. A message stating that the output was successful does not mean that the backup can be restored. A sample must be restored to an isolated test environment, and both the number of items and the access rules must be cross-referenced. Samples must not be restored to the production environment. Do not send notification emails from the test environment. Even if regular jobs are automatically enabled by the restoration process, the jobs must be reverted to disabled.

In Phase 1, documents owned by the Research Department will be migrated. In Phase 2, documents from all departments except the Finance Department will be migrated. Documents from the Finance Department will remain in the old system until a verification report is approved by the Finance Manager. Approval for the Research Department does not imply approval for the Finance Department's documents. Shared documents will be classified by the owner, not by the affiliation of the last person who edited them. Therefore, documents owned by the Research Department, even if shared with the Finance Department, are subject to Phase 1.

During verification, compare 200 randomly selected documents with the originals. The identifier, creation date, attachment file name, and permissions must match. Differences in whitespace in the plain text of the description field can be ignored, but differences in whitespace within attached source code must not be ignored. If even one instance is found where permissions allow broader access than the original, stop the migration immediately. If the optional description field is empty, it will be recorded for later correction, but this alone does not require a rollback. This does not mean that missing attachments can be ignored.

A rollback is possible until the first new document is created in the new system. If the old database is restored without cross-referencing subsequent new writes, there is a risk of losing user data. If a critical failure is discovered after new writes have begun, do not restore immediately, but switch to read-only mode and contact the failure response manager. The determination of whether cross-referencing is necessary is made by the failure response manager, not the contractor. Record this judgment in the failure log.

Finally, the completion notification will be issued after the owners of each migrated department confirm access. If Finance Department documents remain in the old system, you must not state that the Finance Department has been migrated. The original backup will be retained for 14 days, and after that, it will be deleted only after receiving written approval from the data retention manager. 14 days is the minimum retention period and is not the deadline for automatic deletion. This concludes the migration plan.

---
Minutes of the Regional Library Meeting

At Tuesday's meeting, there was no opposition to the idea of extending evening opening hours. However, not everyone agreed with the proposed plan as it was presented. Ms. Nomura, who is in charge of volunteers, stated that while they could increase evening coverage by two days in December, she could not promise to maintain the same structure in January. The chairperson requested that this be recorded as a temporary proposal, not a permanent staffing arrangement. Of the three people who offered cooperation, only two have completed the necessary training.

The budget proposal is 480,000 yen, tax included. This includes costs for lighting, cleaning, and temporary security contracts, but it does not include the purchase cost of new computers. While the subsidy covers up to 60% of eligible expenses, the upper limit is 240,000 yen. The accountant pointed out that simply multiplying the entire budget by 60% would exceed the limit, and an error in calculating the subsidy amount could occur. The subsidy has been applied for, but its grant has not yet been decided. Residents must not be told that all funding for extended hours has been secured.

Opinions were divided regarding the phrase "anyone can use it" in the informational text. While a library card is not required just to enter the reading room, registration is still necessary to borrow books. Children under 12 visiting after 7:00 PM are required to be accompanied by an adult. This restriction applies only to nighttime and does not change existing daytime rules. The proposal to label everyone under 18 as a child was rejected because it would incorrectly extend restrictions to older students.

During the discussion, an email from the building manager was presented. It stated, "We will make the entrance usable by next Friday." Initially, this was interpreted as the completion of all renovations, but the next sentence specified that painting in the west corridor would continue for another week and that it would be closed during that time. Only the entrance and the path to the reading room would be usable. The manager promised access to part of the building, not the completion of all renovations.

The committee agreed to conduct trial operations on December 8th and 15th, conditional upon the safety inspection being completed by December 5th. If the inspection is delayed, both dates will be canceled, and there will be no automatic postponement to the following week. Those who reserved study seats will be contacted individually. General visitors will be notified via the website. Simply posting a cancellation notice will not suffice as a substitute for contacting reservation holders.

As they left, the chairperson thanked Ms. Nomura, saying, "You saved the plan." Ms. Nomura smiled and replied, "Let's see if we can save two nights first." This was a cautious statement, not a rejection of the idea itself. The secretary added that a permanent change to opening hours has not been approved, and the trial results will be reviewed before making a decision regarding January. The meeting concluded without a vote on the permanent plan. These are the meeting minutes.

移行は、11月21日土曜日の01:00から04:00（UTC）に予定されています。本通知全体を通して、時間はUTCで表記されています。ローカルタイムを代入する場合は、明示的なラベルを付与しなければなりません。メンテナンスウィンドウは最大許容時間であり、サービスが3時間利用不可であることを保証するものではありません。ユーザーは以前に公開された文書を読み続けることができます。新しい文書の作成とアクセス許可の変更は一時的に無効になります。メンテナンスウィンドウの前に生成されたダウンロードリンクは、元の有効期限まで引き続き機能します。

ウィンドウが始まる前に、運用チームは権限テーブルをエクスポートし、各エクスポートファイルに対してチェックサムを計算する必要があります。単にエクスポートが成功したというメッセージだけでは、バックアップが使用可能であるという十分な証拠にはなりません。チームは、サンプルを隔離されたテスト環境に復元し、レコード数とアクセスルールを両方比較しなければなりません。サンプルを本番環境に復元してはいけません。テスト環境は通知メールを送信してはならず、復元プロセスが自動的に有効にした場合でも、そのスケジュールされたジョブは無効のまま維持されなければなりません。

最初のステージは、研究部門が所有する文書を移動します。第2ステージは、財務部門を除くすべての部門が所有する文書を移動します。財務部門の文書は、財務マネージャーが別途検証レポートを承認するまで、古いシステムに残ります。研究ステージの承認は、財務文書の承認を意味するものではありません。共有文書は、最後に編集した人物の所属部門ではなく、所有者によって分類されます。したがって、財務部門と共有されているが研究部門が所有する文書は、第1ステージに属します。

検証中、ランダムに選択された200の文書をオリジナルと比較します。すべての文書識別子、作成日、添付ファイル名、および権限エントリが一致している必要があります。プレーンテキストの説明内の空白の違いは無視しても構いませんが、ソースコード添付ファイル内の違いは無視してはなりません。もしいずれかの権限エントリがオリジナルよりも広範なアクセスを許可している場合、直ちに移行を停止してください。オプションの説明が欠落している場合は、後で修正するために記録する必要がありますが、それ自体がロールバックを必要とするわけではありません。この区別は、チームが添付ファイルの欠落を無視することを許可するものではありません。

ロールバックは、代替システムで最初の新しい文書が作成されるまで利用可能です。そのイベントの後、新しい書き込みを調整せずに古いデータベースを復元すると、ユーザーデータが失われる可能性があります。新しい書き込みが開始された後に重大な不具合が発見された場合は、直ちにデータベースを復元する代わりに、読み取り専用モードに切り替え、インシデントコーディネーターに連絡してください。コーディネーターが、ベンダーではなく、調整が必要かどうかを決定します。その決定をインシデントログに記録してください。

最後に、移行された各部門の所有者がアクセスを確認した後でのみ、完了通知を送信してください。財務部門の文書がまだ古いシステムにある場合、「財務部門が移動した」とは主張しないでください。元のバックアップは14日間保持し、保持担当者が書面で承認した後でのみ削除してください。14日間は最低保持期間であり、自動削除の期限ではありません。移行計画の終了。

火曜日に図書館委員会が会った際、夕方の開館時間を延長することに異議を唱える者は誰もいませんでした。しかし、それは全員が提案された内容を支持したことを意味するわけではありません。ボランティアを管理しているノラは、12月にはさらに2日間の夕方をカバーできると述べましたが、1月には同じ手配を約束することはできませんでした。議長は書記に対し、これを恒久的な人員配置のコミットメントとしてではなく、一時的な申し出として記録するよう求めました。3人のボランティアが協力を申し出ていましたが、必要なトレーニングを完了したのは2人だけでした。

提案された予算は、税込みで480,000円でした。これは照明、清掃、および一時的な警備契約をカバーしていましたが、新しいコンピューターの購入は含まれていませんでした。助成金は、上限240,000円の範囲で、適格な費用の最大60%を払い戻すことになります。会計担当者は、その上限があるため、総予算に60%を掛けると誤った払い戻し額になることを指摘しました。助成金は申請されていましたが、まだ採択されていませんでした。誰も、延長された開館時間がすでに完全に資金提供されていると住民に伝えるべきではありません。

また、草案の通知に含まれる「誰でも利用可能」というフレーズについても意見の相違がありました。利用者は閲覧室に入るために図書館カードを必要としませんが、本の貸し出しには依然として登録が必要です。12歳未満の子供は、19:00以降は付き添いの大人が必要です。この制限は夕方の訪問のみに関わるものであり、日中の訪問に関する既存のルールを変更するものではありませんでした。委員会は、18歳未満のすべての訪問者を子供と記述するという提案を却下しました。なぜなら、それはより年長の生徒にまで制限を誤って拡大してしまうからです。

議論の途中で、ケンは建物の管理者からのメールを読みました。「来週の金曜日までにエントランスを利用可能にできます」と書かれていました。ケンは当初、これを改修がその時までに完了することを意味すると解釈しました。ノラは次の文に気づきました。西側の廊下ではさらに1週間塗装が続くこと、そしてその廊下は閉鎖されたままであること。利用可能になるのはエントランスと閲覧室へのルートのみでした。管理者は建物の一部へのアクセスを約束しただけで、改修全体の完了を約束したわけではありませんでした。

委員会は、安全検査が12月5日までに完了することを条件に、12月8日と15日に試行を実施することに同意しました。もし検査が遅れた場合、自動的に翌週に延期されるのではなく、両方の試行日がキャンセルされます。学習デスクを予約した人々には個別に通知されます。一般の訪問者は図書館のウェブサイトで告知を確認します。キャンセル通知を印刷することは、予約のある人々への連絡に代わるものではありません。

退室する際、議長は「計画を救ってくれた」としてノラに感謝を述べました。彼女は微笑み、「まず2日間の夕方を救えたかどうか見てみましょう」と言いました。彼女のコメントは慎重なものであり、アイデアの拒否ではありませんでした。書記は最後に以下の注記を追加しました。開館時間の恒久的な変更は承認されておらず、1月に関するいかなる決定も、試行の結果が検討された後に下されること。会議は恒久的な提案についての採決なしに終了しました。会議議事録の終了。

Kitako Document Service Migration Plan

The migration work is scheduled from 01:00 to 04:00 UTC on Saturday, November 21st. All times in this notice are expressed in UTC, and must not be replaced with local time without explicit indication. These three hours represent the maximum window available for the work, and it does not necessarily mean that the service will be stopped for the full three hours. Viewing published documents will continue to be possible. The creation of new documents and changes to access permissions will be temporarily suspended. Download links issued before the work begins can be used until their original expiration date.

Before starting the work, the operations staff must output the permissions table and calculate the checksum for each output file. A message stating that the output was successful does not mean that the backup can be restored. A sample must be restored to an isolated test environment, and both the number of items and the access rules must be cross-referenced. Do not restore samples to the production environment. Do not send notification emails from the test environment. Even if regular jobs are automatically activated by the restoration process, the jobs must be reverted to an inactive state.

Phase 1 will migrate documents owned by the Research Department. Phase 2 will migrate documents from all departments except the Finance Department. Documents belonging to the Finance Department will remain in the old system until a verification report is approved by the Finance Manager. Approval regarding the Research Department does not imply approval of the Finance documents. Shared documents will be classified by the owner, not by the department of the last person who edited them. Therefore, documents owned by the Research Department, even if shared with the Finance Department, are subject to Phase 1.

During verification, compare 200 randomly selected documents with the originals. The identifier, creation date, attachment file name, and permissions must match. Differences in whitespace within the plain text of the description field may be ignored, but differences in whitespace within the attached source code must not be ignored. If even one instance is found where permissions allow broader access than the original, immediately stop the migration. If the optional description field is empty, we will record it for later correction, but this alone does not require a rollback. This does not mean that missing attachments can be ignored.

A rollback is possible until the first new document is created in the new system. If the old database is restored without cross-referencing subsequent new writes, there is a risk of losing user data. If a critical failure is discovered after new writes have begun, do not immediately restore; instead, switch to read-only mode and contact the failure response manager. The determination of whether cross-referencing is necessary is made by the failure response manager, not the vendor. Record this judgment in the failure log.

Finally, the completion notification will be issued after the owners of each migrated department confirm access. If Finance documents remain in the old system, you must not state that the Finance Department has been migrated. The original backup will be retained for 14 days, and after that, it will be deleted only after receiving written approval from the data retention manager. 14 days is the minimum retention period and is not the deadline for automatic deletion. This concludes the migration plan.

---

Local Library Meeting Minutes

At Tuesday's meeting, there was no opposition to the idea of extending evening opening hours. However, not everyone fully agreed with the proposed plan. Nomura-san, who is responsible for volunteers, stated that while they could increase evening coverage by two days in December, they could not promise to maintain the same structure in January. The chairperson requested that this be recorded as a temporary proposal, not a permanent staffing solution. Of the three people who offered cooperation, only two have completed the necessary training.

The budget proposal is 480,000 yen, tax included. This includes lighting, cleaning, and temporary security contracts, but does not include the cost of purchasing new computers. While the subsidy covers up to 60% of the eligible expenses, the upper limit is 240,000 yen. The accounting staff pointed out that simply multiplying the entire budget by 60% would exceed the limit, and that the subsidy amount could be miscalculated. Although the subsidy has been applied for, its grant has not yet been decided. Residents must not be told that all funding for the extended hours has been secured.

Opinions were divided regarding the phrase "anyone can use it" in the informational text. While a library card is not required just to enter the reading room, registration is still required if books are borrowed. We require adults to accompany children under 12 who visit after 7:00 PM. This restriction applies only to the evenings and does not change existing daytime rules. The proposal to refer to everyone under 18 as a child was rejected because it would incorrectly expand the restrictions to older students.

During the discussion, an email from the building manager was presented. It stated, "We will make the entrance usable by next Friday." Initially, this was interpreted as meaning the entire renovation would be complete, but the next sentence stated that painting in the west corridor would continue for another week and that it would be closed during that time. The only usable areas are the entrance and the path to the reading room. The manager promised access to part of the building, not the completion of the entire renovation.

The committee agreed to conduct trial runs on December 8th and 15th, conditional upon the safety inspection being completed by December 5th. If the inspection is delayed, both days will be canceled, and there will be no automatic postponement to the following week. We will contact those who reserved study seats individually. We will notify general visitors via the website. Simply posting a cancellation notice will not suffice as a substitute for contacting reservation holders.

As they left, the chairperson thanked Nomura-san, saying, "You saved the plan." Nomura-san smiled and replied, "Let's see if we can save two nights first." This was a cautious statement and did not mean that the idea itself was rejected. The secretary added that a permanent change to opening hours has not been approved, and the trial results will be reviewed before making a decision regarding January. The meeting concluded without a vote on the permanent plan. This concludes the meeting minutes.

North Port Document Service Migration Plan

The migration work is scheduled from 01:00 to 04:00 UTC on Saturday, November 21. All times in this notice are expressed in UTC and must not be converted to local time without explicit instruction. This three-hour window is the maximum time available for work; it does not mean that the service will necessarily be down for three hours. Viewing of already published documents will remain possible. Creation of new documents and changes to access permissions will be temporarily suspended. Download links issued before the work begins can be used until their original expiration dates.

Before starting the work, operations personnel must output the permission table and calculate the checksum for each output file. A message stating that the output was successful does not mean that the backup is restorable. One sample must be restored to an isolated test environment, and both the count and the access rules must be cross-referenced. Do not restore samples to the production environment. Do not send notification emails from the test environment. Even if periodic jobs are automatically enabled by the restoration process, the jobs must be set back to disabled.

In Phase 1, documents owned by the Research Department will be migrated. In Phase 2, documents from all remaining departments except the Finance Department will be migrated. Finance Department documents will remain in the old system until the Finance Manager approves a separate verification report. Approval regarding the Research Department does not imply approval of the Finance documents. Shared documents are classified by owner, not by the affiliation of the last person to edit them. Therefore, documents owned by the Research Department that are shared with the Finance Department are subject to Phase 1.

During verification, compare 200 randomly selected documents with the originals. Each item—identifier, creation date, attachment filename, and permissions—must match. Differences in whitespace within the plaintext of the description field may be ignored, but differences in whitespace within source code attachments must not be ignored. If even one instance of permissions granting broader access than the original is found, stop the migration immediately. If any optional description field is empty, record it for correction at a later date, but that alone does not require a rollback. This does not mean that missing attachments may be ignored.

A rollback is possible until the first new document is created in the new system. Restoring the old database after that point without cross-referencing new writes risks losing user data. If a critical failure is identified after new writes have begun, do not restore immediately; instead, switch to read-only mode and contact the failure response manager. The decision on whether cross-referencing is necessary is made by the failure response manager, not the contractor. Record that decision in the failure log.

Finally, a completion notice will be issued after the owners of each migrated department confirm access. If Finance documents remain in the old system, do not state that they have been migrated to the Finance Department. The original backup will be held for 14 days and deleted thereafter only after obtaining written approval from the storage management manager. 14 days is the minimum retention period and is not the automatic deletion deadline. The above is the migration plan.

Community Library Meeting Minutes

In Tuesday's meeting, no one opposed the idea of extending the nighttime opening hours. However, not everyone agreed to the proposed plan as presented. Mr. Nomura, who is in charge of volunteers, stated that while they could increase nighttime coverage by two days in December, he could not promise to maintain the same structure in January. The chair requested that this be recorded as a temporary offer rather than a permanent staffing guarantee. Of the three people who offered cooperation, only two have completed the necessary training.

The budget proposal is 480,000 yen including tax. It includes lighting, cleaning, and temporary security contracts, but does not include the cost of purchasing new computers. While the subsidy covers up to 60% of the eligible expenses, the cap is 240,000 yen. The accountant pointed out that simply multiplying the total budget by 60% would exceed the cap and result in an incorrect subsidy amount. The subsidy has been applied for, but the disbursement has not yet been decided. Do not explain to residents that the funding for the extended hours has been fully secured.

Opinions were divided regarding the expression "anyone can use it" in the information notice. A library card is not required just to enter the reading room, but registration is still required to borrow books. Children under the age of 12 visiting after 19:00 will be required to be accompanied by an adult. This restriction applies only to the nighttime, and the existing daytime rules will not change. The proposal to refer to everyone under 18 as "children" was not adopted because it would mistakenly extend restrictions to older students.

During the discussion, an email from the building manager was introduced. It states, "We will make the entrance available by next Friday." Initially, this was taken to mean that the entire renovation would be finished, but the next sentence stated that painting of the west corridor would continue for another week, and it would be closed during that time. Only the entrance and the path to the reading room are usable. What the manager promised was access to part of the building, not the completion of the entire renovation.

The committee agreed to conduct trials on December 8 and 15, on the condition that the safety inspection is completed by December 5. If the inspection is delayed, both days will be canceled, and there will be no automatic postponement to the following week. Individuals who have reserved study seats will be contacted individually. General visitors will be notified on the website. Posting a cancellation notice alone does not replace contacting the reservation holders.

At the end, the chair thanked Mr. Nomura, saying, "You saved the plan." Mr. Nomura laughed and replied, "Let's see first if we saved two nights." This was a cautious statement and did not mean he rejected the idea itself. The secretary added that the permanent change to opening hours has not been approved and that the results of the trials will be reviewed before making a decision regarding January. The meeting concluded without a vote on the permanent proposal. These are the meeting minutes.

        North Port Document Service Migration Plan
        The migration work is scheduled from 01:00 to 04:00 UTC on Saturday, November 21. All times in this notice are expressed in UTC and must not be converted to local time without explicit indication. This three-hour window is the maximum time available for the work and does not mean that the service will necessarily be down for three hours. Viewing of already published documents will remain possible. The creation of new documents and changes to access permissions will be temporarily suspended. Download links issued before the work will remain usable until their original expiration dates.

        Before the start of the work, operations personnel must output the permission table and calculate the checksum for each output file. A message stating that the output was successful does not mean that the backup is restorable. One sample must be restored to an isolated test environment, and both the number of items and the access rules must be verified. Samples must not be restored to the production environment. Do not send notification emails from the test environment. Even if periodic jobs are automatically enabled by the restoration process, the jobs must be set back to disabled.

        In Phase 1, documents owned by the research department will be migrated. In Phase 2, documents from all remaining departments except the finance department will be migrated. Documents of the finance department will remain in the old system until the finance head approves a separate verification report. Approval regarding the research department does not mean approval of the finance documents. Shared documents are classified by owner, not by the department of the person who last edited them. Therefore, documents owned by the research department that are shared with the finance department are subject to Phase 1.

        During verification, please compare 200 randomly selected documents with the originals. Each item, including identifiers, creation dates, attachment filenames, and permissions, must match. Differences in whitespace within plain text in the description field may be ignored, but differences in whitespace within source code attachments must not be ignored. If even one instance of permission allowing broader access than the original is found, stop the migration immediately. If any optional description field is empty, it will be recorded for correction at a later date, but that alone does not require a rollback. This does not mean that missing attachments may be ignored.

        Rollback is possible until the first new document is created in the new system. Restoring the old database after that point without verifying new writes risks losing user data. If a major failure is identified after the start of new writes, do not restore immediately; instead, switch to read-only and contact the incident response lead. The decision on whether verification is necessary is made by the incident response lead, not the vendor. Record that decision in the incident log.

        Finally, a completion notice will be issued after the owners of each migrated department have confirmed access. If finance documents remain in the old system, it must not be stated that they have been migrated to the finance department. The original backups will be held for 14 days and will be deleted only after obtaining written approval from the storage management lead. 14 days is the shortest retention period and is not an automatic deletion deadline. This concludes the migration plan.

    *   *Drafting Section 2:*
        Community Library Meeting Minutes
        In Tuesday's meeting, there was no one who opposed the idea of extending the nighttime opening hours. However, not everyone agreed to the proposed plan as presented. Mr. Nomura, who is in charge of volunteers, spoke about how they could increase nighttime coverage by two days in December, but he could not promise that the same arrangement could be maintained in January. The chair requested that this be recorded as a temporary offer rather than a permanent staffing guarantee. Of the three people who offered cooperation, only two have completed the necessary training.

        The budget proposal is 480,000 yen including tax. It includes costs for lighting, cleaning, and a temporary security contract, but does not include the purchase cost of new computers. Although the subsidy covers up to 60% of the eligible expenses, the cap is 240,000 yen. The accountant pointed out that simply multiplying 60% by the total budget would exceed the cap and result in an incorrect subsidy amount. The subsidy has been applied for, but the delivery has not yet been decided. Do not explain to residents that all funding for the extended hours has been secured.

        Opinions were divided regarding the expression "anyone can use it" in the information notice. While a library card is not required just to enter the reading room, registration is still required to borrow books. Children under the age of 12 visiting after 19:00 will be required to be accompanied by an adult. This restriction applies only to the nighttime, and the existing daytime rules remain unchanged. The proposal to refer to everyone under 18 as "children" was not adopted because it would incorrectly extend restrictions to older students.

        During the discussion, an email from the building manager was introduced. It stated, "The entrance will be usable by next Friday." While this was initially taken to mean that the entire renovation would be finished, the next sentence stated that painting of the west corridor would continue for another week, and it would be closed during that time. Only the entrance and the path to the reading room are usable. What the manager promised was access to part of the building, not the completion of the entire renovation.

        The committee agreed to conduct trials on December 8 and 15, on the condition that the safety inspection is completed by December 5. If the inspection is delayed, both days will be cancelled, and there will be no automatic postponement to the following week. Those who have reserved study seats will be contacted individually. General visitors will be notified on the website. Posting a cancellation notice alone does not substitute for contacting the reservation holders.

        At the end, the chair thanked Mr. Nomura, saying, "You saved the plan." Mr. Nomura laughed and replied, "Let's see first if we saved two nights." This was a cautious remark and did not mean a rejection of the idea itself. The secretary added that the permanent change to opening hours has not been approved and that the results of the trials will be reviewed before making a decision regarding January. The meeting concluded without a vote on the permanent plan. These are the meeting minutes.
